reason: I can get a bottle of magnesium glycinate at the store for way less per day, and I'd rather wait for a coupon. Two capsules a day is one more thing I'd forget on the counter anyway.
objection: $24.99 to $29.99 for 30 days is more than I pay for a bottle that lasts two months, and I forget vitamins half the time so I'd be paying for sachets I never take.
would_change_my_mind: A first box at about $15 or a real flash-sale or coupon price, so I can try it without feeling like I wasted money if I forget to take it.
